full_ci.source: GitHub checks for the pushed PR head

manual: Dropped updates recover through canonical snapshots after reconnect
Duplicate and reordered sequence 1,4,4,2,3 does not duplicate approvals
Draft and selected flow/version/run remain unchanged
Selected run status refreshes to paused
Unavailable memory is stale with unknown count; recovered empty memory has server count zero
limitations: Default-off optional host; no production or D-stack assembly/activation
No exactly-once delivery, immediate cross-client forgetting or cross-domain atomic snapshot guarantee
Polling repairs final dropped events and missing producers after successful reads; background tabs may throttle timers
Pagination is bounded and unknown totals remain null; legacy goals have a 100-row cap; opportunities retain their existing offset-cursor semantics
No paid models, real external effects, sidecar or hosted deployment checks
Behavior fixture is not visual/accessibility certification of assembled Brief rooms
rollback: Disable/unregister reconciliation or omit the host client; stop it to retire reads and clear its identity-local cache. Retain all canonical histories, drafts and compatibility readers.
